__purpose: Player node: convert an incoming effect chain into visualEffects commands for routing to Client/Display sinks.
label: Effect Player

metadata.description: Converts an effect chain into visualEffects commands for Client or Display sinks.

compatibility.rule: Connect cmd output to Display to route visual effects to selected Display endpoints.
compatibility.repairHint: If effects are not visible on Display, confirm the Display node is connected and routed to the correct targets.

compatibility.rule: Connect cmd output to Client Executor to route visual effects to audience clients.

repairHints: An empty effect input emits visualEffects with an empty effects array.
